SUPRIYA BHAGAT

Senior Data Scientist | +91 9004002618 | bhagatsupriya01@gmail.com | Github | linkedin

CAREER SUMMARY

Senior Data Scientist with 5+ years of experience in Generative AI, Machine Learning, and cloud-native AI platforms. Designed and deployed LLMs, RAG systems, Agentic Solutions, Recommendation engines, and ML Models using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI and LangChain. Hands-on with vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Milvus, ChromaDB), LLM finetuning (LoRA/QLoRA), and LLMOps. Proven record of leading development of MLOps, CI/CD Pipeline with measurable business impact across NLP and predictive analysis.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Programming: Python, SQL, R

Generative AI & Agents: LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, LlaMa, Qwen, Mistral), Prompt Engineering, MCP, AI Agents (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI), LangChain, HuggingFace, Ollama, RAG, Vector Databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Milvus, ChromaDB), LLM finetuning (LoRA/QLoRA), LLMOps

Backend & APIs: FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, Gradio, REST, async workers, Redis, PostgreSQL, AWS RDS

Cloud & MLOps: AWS (EC2, ECS GPU, S3, CloudWatch), Docker, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), GCP, Azure

Data Science & ML: Data Analysis, Data Preprocessing, Feature Engineering, A/B testing, Supervised ML, Unsupervised ML, NLP, Recommendation Systems, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Deep Learning

Leadership: Team Leadership, Stakeholder Alignment, Problem Decomposition, Product Management

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Data Scientist | ProjectPro	2024 - Present

Personalized Customer Outreach and Support AI Agent (CrewAI)

Led the productionization of an enterprise-grade agentic solution for customer outreach(CrewAI + Twilio + ElevenLabs) that initiates daily customer calls using GPT-4o prompts grounded in call recordings and CRM context; deployed as FastAPI on AWS EC2 with RDS and scheduled jobs. Achieved 40% increase in call connection, improving renewal and feedback follow-ups.

AI-powered Customer Support Assistant with fine-tuned LLM

Fine-tuned Llama via LoRA and shipped a RAG-backed support assistant (Pinecone/Qdrant, guardrails, LangChain, Ollama) on GPU-backed EC2 (Docker, health checks, auto-rollback, CloudWatch). Result: reduced average ticket first-response from 12h to 5m and deflected 70% of L1 tickets.

Data Scientist | ProjectPro	2023 - 2024

LLM-Powered Adaptive Quiz Generation Platform

Built a schema-validated MCQ generator (RAG + Whisper ASR; GPT-o3/Claude) deployed on AWS (Docker, GitHub Actions, S3, CloudWatch). Adoption: used across 300+ projects / 1,000+ blog posts;

+20% engagement and organic traffic



Customer Refund Risk Prediction using Machine Learning Model

Led development of End-to-End data pipeline and classification models to flag early refund risk; Feature engineering and SHAP for explainability; A/B tested interventions via Activation Metric framework resulting in 38% refund rate reduction and 65% lift in user activation.

Associate Data Scientist | ProjectPro	2021 - 2023

Content-Based Recommendation Engine for Personalized Learning Paths

Spearheaded the company’s first recommender engine to personalize learning paths; Built a content- based model to establish personalization roadmap. Increased engagement to 2× repeat-session users and +35% average session length. End-to-end delivery with FastAPI on AWS API Gateway.

Product Analytics ETL & Cohort Retention Platform

Scoped requirements, designed architecture, built and deployed AWS Lambda-SQL models, set up monitoring/alerts, and operated the platform in production. Resolved data quality via validation, deduplication, normalization; Modeled DAU/MAU, engagement, Cohort-Retention tables; shipped executive Looker dashboards; Cut manual reporting by 90% via reusable SQL transforms and schedules.

Researcher | Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai	2020 - 2021

Co-authored a research paper published in Chaos, Solitons and Fractals by Elsevier titled Empirical detection of parameter variation in growth curve models. Implemented and analyzed biological growth models using real and simulated datasets; validated the proposed ISRP-based model selection technique

EDUCATION

M.Sc., Engineering Mathematics | Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai	2018 - 2020

B.Sc., Mathematics | University of Mumbai	2015 - 2018
